newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan's Bashir releases women from crowded prison.
newsitem.headline: Sudan's Bashir releases women from crowded prison.

text.p: Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir has ordered the release of 192 women from an overcrowded prison in the city of Omdurman, a privately-owned newspaper said on Thursday.
The prison was designed to house 100 inmates but is in fact holding around 600 women, some with their babies, al-Akhbar al-Youm said.
Most of the women held at Omdurman prison have been convicted in cases related to manufacturing or selling liquor, which is outlawed by the Islamic penal code applied in Sudan.
